profile.name: Winners Hotel and Suites
profile.address: Godwin Abbey Way (Limit Rd), Benin City, Edo State

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.tagline: Thoughtfully designed for a relaxing and affordable stay without compromising comfort or quality.
rooms.description: Our Standard Room is thoughtfully designed to provide guests with a relaxing and affordable stay without compromising comfort or quality. Perfect for solo travelers, couples, and short business visits, the room offers a calm and welcoming atmosphere ideal for rest and productivity.
amenities: Smart TV with Streaming & Fiber Wi-Fi

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.tagline: Extra space, style, and convenience combining modern luxury with warm hospitality.
rooms.description: Experience a higher level of comfort in our Deluxe Room, designed for guests who appreciate extra space, style, and convenience. Combining modern luxury with warm hospitality, this room creates the perfect environment for relaxation after a busy day.
amenities: Welcome Cocktail at Gold Room Lounge

rooms.name: Executive Room
rooms.tagline: Specially crafted for premium comfort, privacy, and sophistication.
rooms.description: Our Executive Room is specially crafted for guests seeking premium comfort, privacy, and sophistication. With stylish interiors, spacious accommodation, and enhanced amenities, this room offers a truly refined hospitality experience.

rooms.name: Suite Room
rooms.tagline: Separate living and sleeping areas with modern elegance for extended stays.
rooms.description: Our Suite Room offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and modern elegance for guests who desire a more spacious and refined experience. Beautifully designed with separate living and sleeping areas, the Suite provides the ideal environment for relaxation, business, and extended stays.
amenities: VIP Reserved Table at Gold Room Lounge

rooms.name: Presidential Room
rooms.tagline: The highest standard of luxury, exclusivity, and prestige at Winners Hotel and Suites.
rooms.description: The Presidential Room represents the highest standard of luxury and prestige at Winners Hotel and Suites. Designed for distinguished guests who desire elegance, exclusivity, and world-class comfort, this exceptional accommodation delivers an unforgettable experience.

amenities.title: Luxury Rooms + Free Breakfast
amenities.description: Five luxury room tiers with 24/7 uninterrupted power, fiber Wi-Fi, and complimentary daily continental & local breakfast.

amenities.title: 24/7 Gym & Swimming · Gym Memberships
amenities.description: Floodlit resort swimming pool and 24-hour fitness studio open to in-house guests and monthly Gym Membership subscribers.

amenities.title: Gold Room Lounge
amenities.description: Signature warm-lit leather and brass lounge pouring aged spirits, craft cocktails, and curated platters with attentive table service.

amenities.title: Event & Meeting Halls · Celebration Dinners
amenities.description: Acoustically equipped banquet halls, corporate conference suites, and private candlelit setups for milestone Celebration Dinners.

amenities.title: Winners Kitchen (24/7) – Takeout & Delivery
amenities.description: Round-the-clock Local & Intercontinental dishes cooked fresh to order for suite service, quick takeout, or Benin City doorstep delivery.

amenities.title: On-Site Supermarket
amenities.description: Well-stocked hospitality convenience mart with chilled beverages, imported snacks, toiletries, wines, and everyday travel essentials.

amenities.title: Photo Shoots & Editorial Locations
amenities.description: Bookable architectural backdrops, golden-hour poolside decks, and private suite sets for bridal, fashion, and brand photo shoots.

amenities.title: Winners Unisex Salon & Spa
amenities.description: Serving both male and female guests with precision haircuts, grooming, hair styling, and rejuvenating cosmetic & spa treatments.

amenities.title: Winners Luxury Fashion Boutique
amenities.description: Curated quality fashion, designer sneakers, footwear, caps, belts, and statement apparel so you can shop the lifestyle of luxury on-site.

amenities.title: Games & Entertainment Lounge
amenities.description: We keep you busy and entertained with Snooker boards, Table Soccer, PS4, and PS5 console stations for friendly guest competition.

amenities.title: Chauffeur Shuttle & 24/7 Security
amenities.description: Benin Airport pickups with experienced drivers, monitored CCTV perimeter, and round-the-clock uniformed security personnel.
